title: Webb County Tax Office Wishes Residents a Blessed Thanksgiving Weekend
excerpt: The Webb County Tax Office wished Webb County residents a blessed Thanksgiving weekend, greeting everyone on Thanksgiving morning.
content:
The Webb County Tax Office wished Webb County residents a blessed Thanksgiving weekend on Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026, Thanksgiving Day.

In a Thanksgiving morning greeting, the Tax Office told residents to have a blessed Thanksgiving weekend.
